Marcus Lee: Hey folks — couple quick onboarding Qs. I enrolled in medical/dental/vision but don't see an FSA option in the portal. Is that a separate signup? Also my direct deposit still shows as "pending" in payroll. Anything I missed? Finally, if I start mid-May will I still get Juneteenth off/policy on holiday pay or is that prorated?
Priya (People Ops): Hi @Marcus and welcome! Short answers: 1) FSA is optional and has its own election screen in the benefits portal (Benefits -> Flexible Spending). If you don't see it, try toggling the plan year dropdown (2026) or clear cookies. We also have a short enrollment window: new hires get 30 days from start date to elect FSA/Commuter plans. 2) Direct deposit: Payroll requires bank verification. We send micro-deposits within 24-48 hrs of you entering bank info; once you confirm the amounts in the payroll portal we flip it from pending to active. If you used Plaid then it usually goes active immediately. 3) Holidays: Redwood company holidays are paid if you are an active employee on the observed holiday date. They are not pro-rated based on start date (so if you are employed on 2026-06-19 you'll get the day paid). PTO accruals are prorated/retroactive depending on your start date and accrual schedule.
Marcus Lee: Great, thanks. I did enter bank details but maybe I never confirmed micro-deposits. Where do I check the payroll portal to confirm amounts?
Finance Bot: Payroll notification: Micro-deposits sent to account ending in 4321 on 2026-03-30. Please confirm amounts in Payroll Portal -> Bank & Payment Methods. If unconfirmed within 10 days we will re-send verification.
Marcus Lee: Saw it 10 I confirmed and it switched to active. Thanks! One more: I have some moving receipts that I need reimbursed; does that go to Concur or Expensify?
Dana (Hiring Manager): @Marcus we routed recruitment relocation through the Recruiting/Relocation policy. For your hire packet it was listed as expensify/people-ops reimbursement. Check the relocation section of Confluence and tag @Priya when you submit so we don't miss it.
Priya (People Ops): Confirming: submit moving receipts to Expensify under policy "Relocation - Recruiting" and include your offer ID (OFFER-7782). For urgent reimbursement we can also issue an advance  file a ticket in the people-ops queue titled "Relocation Advance: Marcus Lee" and include the requested amount and receipts. Processing timeline: typical 1-2 payroll cycles after approval. Links: Benefits portal: https://benefits.redwood.internal/ (Flexible Spending tab), Payroll portal: https://payroll.redwood.internal/ (Bank & Payment Methods), Relocation guide: https://confluence.redwood.internal/relocation-reimburse.
Marcus Lee: Awesome, thanks everyone. Appreciate the quick help. :smile:
